answer: A newcomer plants one lotus in the shared meadow, staking 3,000 POA that freezes like a glacier for 30 epochs. The lotus only blooms after ten established neighbors water it with signed work receipts across those epochs. A fake lotus gets no water and the stake stays frozen forever. Neighbors who water a fake lotus lose 500 POA of their own stake. Faking 50 identities means planting 50 lotus at 3,000 POA each plus forging 500 receipts at 1,000 POA per bribe: 650,000 POA before one fake vote counts. Like a real meadow, nothing blooms without a whole season of neighbors watching it grow.
